summary: All three automated review-site browser journeys passed. No user action is needed for these checks.
scope: Read-only review site only. Product app, model, provider, native offload and whole-software checks keep their separate results.
controls: One background Chrome worker used a fresh output directory and isolated browser contexts.
The fixed proxy required the reference header and format marker, read only the authorized loopback routes, and checked current repository identity and shipped assets.
No app setup, provider credentials, model loading, screenshot, trace, video, download or external publication was part of these cases.
The report retains only fixed phase/result facts. It contains no page contents, private errors, credentials, prompts or local paths.
limits: Source-definition checks and inventory entries do not execute or pass a browser journey. This report records the separately executed three-case command.
Fixture/request cleanup and normal runner exit are ordinary test observations. They do not qualify physical process trees, native file protection, model-worker crash recovery or offload resources.
The controlled refresh cases use a declared synthetic copy and failure. The live case reads the actual bounded local server.
No parent roadmap or final-current-source qualification is granted. Full software/system tests remain deferred until open feature implementation is worked through.
Earlier failed controller/source observations remain preserved. Accepted model accuracy/OCR stay closed, private-provider website checking stays deferred, and headless implementation stays on hold.
